name: Silo Feed Exporter for Houzez
author: pluginsilo

sections.description:
Silo Feed Exporter for Houzez turns your Houzez-powered property listings into secure, ready-to-submit feeds for the real estate portals and apps you actually work with — without writing a single line of code.

Silo Feed Exporter for Houzez is developed by PluginSilo and provides an independent integration for exporting Houzez listings. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Favethemes or Houzez. “Houzez” is used solely to describe compatibility with the Houzez theme, whose data this plugin reads.

Create as many feeds as you need, each with its own independent, tokenized URL, its own generation schedule, and its own field mapping. A guided step-by-step wizard walks you through picking a destination, choosing which properties to include, previewing the field mapping, validating the result, and generating the feed — few clicks, no XML/JSON knowledge required.

Ready-made, pull-based formats

These portals fetch your feed URL directly on their own schedule — just copy the URL into their system:

  • Kyero — XML, verified against Kyero’s own v3 export specification
  • Facebook / Meta — Home Listings catalog XML
  • Thribee / Trovit — XML
  • Dubizzle (Dubai/UAE, also commonly accepted by Bayut) — XML
  • Green-Acres (France/Portugal) — XML
  • MyProperty Direct (Entegral, South Africa/Namibia) — XML
  • European Real Estate (39 European countries) — XML
  • thinkSPAIN — XML
  • OpenImmo (Germany/Austria/Switzerland — Immowelt, Kleinanzeigen.de and 150+ portals) — XML
  • JamesEdition (luxury property marketplace) — XML, with a genuine official validator tool
  • Homeza app — JSON or XML
  • Generic JSON or XML with your own field selection, for any custom app, script, or CRM

FTP-delivered formats

Idealista and BLM don’t accept a pull URL in real life — their real integrations expect the file delivered by FTP. Fill in your FTP host/username/password once and this plugin uploads the generated file automatically after every regeneration, no external script needed.

Data-only formats

Zoopla, Rightmove’s Real Time Data Feed (RTDF), and ShareToBuy require a real-time push API with portal-issued, certificate-based credentials obtained through each platform’s own manual approval process. This plugin generates the correct field structure for these so a developer, relay script, or manual process can complete delivery.

Built-in feed validation

Every fixed-schema feed gets a Feed Health Score — a per-listing check against that platform’s real required fields (not just “did the file generate”), plus document-structure validation (well-formed XML/JSON, valid UTF-8). See exactly which listings would fail, why, and how to fix them, with a direct link back to the property in Houzez.

Secure, portal-friendly URLs

Every feed gets its own security token embedded directly in a clean, human-readable URL. Regenerating the token instantly revokes the old URL — no separate revocation list to manage.

Scheduled generation with real HTTP caching

Feeds can regenerate every 30 minutes, hourly, or daily via WP-Cron, serving a pre-built static file with proper Last-Modified/ETag/Cache-Control headers — so a portal or CDN never has to re-download a feed that hasn’t changed.

Disclaimer

Silo Feed Exporter for Houzez is developed and maintained independently by Team Pluginsilo. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or in any way officially connected with Houzez, Favethemes, Homeza, or any of the third-party real estate portals named above (Kyero, Rightmove, Zoopla, OpenImmo, JamesEdition, Idealista, BLM, and the rest). All product names, logos, and brands referenced are the property of their respective owners and are used only to describe compatibility and intended destination formats.

External services

This plugin’s core function — generating a feed URL that a destination platform fetches on its own schedule — does not itself call any external service; the platform you configure connects to your site, not the other way around. Two specific, optional features do make outbound connections, both fully under your control and off by default:

Homeza Distribution — if you turn on the separate “Homeza Distribution” checkbox on a Homeza-format feed (off by default), this plugin submits that feed’s property data to Homeza’s own intake endpoint (https://app.homeza.org/api/feedsubmit) every time the feed regenerates, so your listings can be published on Homeza.org and in the Homeza app. Sent data: the same property fields (title, description, images, price, location, etc.) already included in that feed. Sent when: on every scheduled or manual regeneration of that feed, only while the checkbox stays enabled. This service is provided by Homeza: terms of service, privacy policy, data processing agreement, cookie policy.

FTP delivery for Idealista/BLM — if you fill in FTP host/username/password on an Idealista or BLM feed (all blank by default), this plugin uploads that feed’s generated file to the FTP server you specified every time it regenerates. Sent data: the same property fields included in that feed’s file. Sent when: on every scheduled or manual regeneration, only while FTP details are filled in. This connects to a server you explicitly configure yourself (typically Idealista’s or BLM’s own FTP intake, or your own relay) — there is no third-party service operated by this plugin’s author involved; consult the terms of whichever party operates the FTP server you configured.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it directly from your WordPress admin’s Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin. (Requires the Houzez theme to be active, since it reads Houzez’s own property data.)
  3. Go to Property Feed in your WordPress admin menu.
  4. Click Add New Feed and follow the guided wizard: pick a destination, choose which properties to include, review the field mapping, validate, and generate.
  5. Copy the feed’s URL into the destination platform (or, for Idealista/BLM, fill in your FTP details instead).
sections.faq:
Is this plugin made by Houzez or Favethemes?

No. This is an independent, third-party plugin developed by Team Pluginsilo. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Houzez or Favethemes. It reads property data from a site running the Houzez theme in order to build feeds for it.

Does this plugin require the Houzez theme?

Yes. It reads property data directly from Houzez’s own post type, meta fields, and taxonomies, so the Houzez theme must be active.

Can I run more than one feed at once?

Yes — create as many feeds as you need, one per destination platform, each with its own independent URL, token, schedule, and field selection.

What happens if I regenerate a feed’s security token?

The feed’s old URL stops working immediately, since the token is embedded directly in the URL itself. Update the URL on the destination platform’s side afterward.

A platform I need isn’t listed — what happens?

The generic JSON and XML formats let you hand-pick exactly which fields to include, for any platform, script, or CRM that can consume a JSON/XML feed at a URL.

Is my data sent anywhere else?

No. This plugin doesn’t transmit any data to its own developer or any third-party analytics/telemetry service. The only outbound connections it ever makes are (a) the feed URL itself being fetched by whichever destination platform you configured, (b) for Idealista/BLM specifically, an FTP upload to the server you explicitly entered credentials for, and (c) for a Homeza-format feed with the separate, off-by-default “Homeza Distribution” checkbox turned on, a submission to Homeza’s own intake endpoint.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial public release. Generate secure, tokenized JSON/XML property feeds from Houzez listings, with ready-made formats for Kyero, Facebook/Meta, Thribee/Trovit, Dubizzle, Green-Acres, MyProperty Direct, European Real Estate, thinkSPAIN, OpenImmo, JamesEdition, and the Homeza app; FTP delivery for Idealista/BLM; data-only output for Zoopla, Rightmove RTDF, and ShareToBuy; a guided step-by-step wizard; per-listing Feed Health Score validation; scheduled generation with HTTP caching; and bulk feed management.
